tools.name: fabtrack_query_wafer_lot_telemetry
tools.description: Returns matching wafer lot telemetry records with Lot_ID, Node, Yield, Status, and Owner filtered by the selected status.
visual_output_keys: lot table with Lot_ID, Node, Yield, Status, and Owner

tools.name: fabtrack_execute_wafer_lot_action
tools.description: Creates the wafer lot action record if the lot ID is new, otherwise updates it. Can set Action Type and Authorized Engineer. Fields not on the form cannot be set.

lot_id.description: Wafer Lot / Invoice ID, e.g. LOT-9920-NV

action_type.description: Action type to execute on the lot.

authorized_engineer.description: Optional authorized engineer name for the status update.

tools.name: fabtrack_open_section
tools.description: Opens the selected portal module section.

tools.name: fabtrack_read_page
tools.description: Read the current page and answer a question about it / extract its visible records.
